title_sq: Ne Kompleksin Me Luksoz Square 21, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Me Hapsira Te Bollshme!!!
description_sq: Ne Kompleksin Me Luksoz Square 21, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Me Hapsira Te Bollshme!!! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 140 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 119.7m2, ndodhet ne katin e nente ne nje pallat te ri 12 katesh aktualisht ne faze rifiniturash. Organizohet ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhomen e gjumit matrimoniale me tualet me dritare , dy dhoma gjumi femijesh dhe nje tualet te bollshem. Apartamenti ka orientim drejt Jug Perendimit, cka sjell ndricim natyral. Kompleksi ndahet ne disa kulla te lidhura me njera tjetren ne nje dizenjim unik i mbushur nga gjelberimi dhe hapesira pushimi per banoret. Disa detaje rreth ndertimit: 1) IZOLIMI AKUSTIK, muret ndarës midis apartamenteve dhe muret ndarës me korridoret e shkallëve do të jenë termikisht të izoluar duke përdorur pambuk mineral me trashësi 50 mm të vendosur ndërmjet dy mureve prej 10 cm(minimizon zhurmat) 2) TERMOIZOLIMI / FASADA, teknologjia e përdorur për termoizolim ju mundëson të keni një ambjent banimi të fresket në verë dhe të ngrohtë në dimër, duke ju kursyer energjine elektrike(balancim temperature per kundrastinet) 3)AMBIENTE TE PERBASHKETA, oborret e brendshme që krijohen, do të trajtohen me hapësira të gjelbërta për ti ofruar një ambjent të jashtëm sa më të mirë dhe të rehatshëm për banorët e objektit: sheshe, trotuare, gjelbërim, ndriçim i jashtëm, shatervane, ambjente shplodhëse dhe hapësira shërbimi për bar, kafe, restorante etj4) Lartesia e apartamenteve 3 m shume e rralle ne tregun tone. Kompleksi Square 21 ka ne perberje te veten dhe Square Wellnes Center e cila eshte nje qender unike relaksi, sporti dhe vetkujdesi, qendra me madhe ne Tirane prej 4500 m2 cila ofron facilitete si Spa, Estetike, Restorant, Palster, Pishine Dimerore etj. Apartamenti ju ofron te gjitha kushtet optimale per nje jetese sa me komode dhe do te ishte nje investim ideal duke konsideruar potencialin e zones ne te cilen ndodhet. Me 2 kate nentoke te dedikuar parkimit, kompleksi Square 21 ofron parkim te sigurt per banoret edhe bizneset prane tij.
title_en: In the most luxurious Square 21 complex, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with ample spaces!!!
description_en: In the most luxurious Square 21 complex, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with ample spaces!!! The apartment with a gross surface area of ​​140 m2 and a net surface area of ​​119.7 m2 is located on the ninth floor of a new 12-story building currently under renovation. It is organized in the living room together with the cooking corner and exit to the balcony, the matrimonial bedroom with a bathroom with a window, two children's bedrooms and a spacious bathroom. The apartment is oriented towards South West, which brings natural light. The complex is divided into several towers connected to each other in a unique design filled with greenery and rest spaces for residents. Some details about the construction: 1) ACOUSTIC INSULATION, the partition walls between the apartments and the partition walls with the stairwells will be thermally insulated using mineral cotton with a thickness of 50 mm placed between two 10 cm walls (minimizes noise) 2) THERMAL INSULATION / FACADE, the technology used for thermal insulation allows you to have a living environment that is cool in summer and warm in winter, saving you energy electric (temperature balancing for the counters) 3) COMMON ENVIRONMENTS, the internal courtyards that are created, will be treated with green spaces to provide the best and most comfortable outdoor environment for the residents of the building: squares, sidewalks, greenery, outdoor lighting, fountains, recreational areas and service areas for bars, cafes, restaurants, etc. 4) The height of the apartments is 3 m, very rare in our market. The Square 21 complex consists of itself and the Square Wellness Center, which is a unique relaxation, sports and self-care center, the largest center in Tirana of 4500 m2, which offers facilities such as Spa, Aesthetics, Restaurant, Gym, Winter Pool, etc. The apartment offers you all the optimal conditions for a comfortable life and would be an ideal investment considering the potential of the area in which it is located. With 2 underground floors dedicated to parking, the Square 21 complex offers safe parking for residents and businesses nearby.
